releaseNotes:
Rookline 0.6.20 protects provider credentials with Windows DPAPI and keeps non-secret settings atomic. Startup migration removes plaintext only after protected storage is verified, and conflicts fail closed.

The runtime now clears inactive game and helper state by generation. Local WebView2 mutations, user-selected file paths, browser rendering, and both loopback hosts have tighter authorization, confinement, escaping, and Content Security Policy boundaries.

The Windows artifacts are Authenticode-signed with the owner-selected self-issued certificate. Other computers will not treat that certificate as publicly trusted unless it is installed there. Rookline verifies the published combined installer with the SHA-256 value in the HTTPS release manifest before updater launch.
